trickyParts: The browser engine's own fix changed the oracle. Once a block of HTML draws as a paragraph holding it as inline HTML, goldmark's reading of a one-line block is the same tree, so the Go refusal written against the old engine refused 36 documents the base read alike. The refusal now fires only where the browser's block swallows a line goldmark reads as the paragraph's own: the node holds another line, or a heading, list, fence, rule or setext underline stands right under it with no blank line between.

The engine's registration order is load-bearing. The block-HTML transform must run after the mark plugins, because a record mark covering whole blocks is written as a line and a line, which are two blocks of HTML until those plugins pair them, and before the typed-block transform, because a paragraph fits a block+ rule where an inline html node does not.

findTableRows gates goldmark's transformer but goldmark always starts at the paragraph's first line and gives up on a header-width mismatch, so reading a table the browser starts after a failed pair needs the leading lines moved into a paragraph of their own first, trimmed exactly as goldmark's paragraph Close trims one, with the blank-previous-lines flag moved with them.
Class P had to land with the table fix: alone it turns nine refusals into stored misreads, whose real cause is a lazy delimiter row.

Two forward merges were needed, each against a real conflict (#2481 and #2458 landed on main in the same day and touch the same files). Both kept each side's behaviour; fixtures.json was regenerated rather than merged, and the fixture name list rebuilt from the corpus directory.
deviations: Class H is not refused. The planner's prototype refused it; the architect decided instead that the browser engine is wrong and must be fixed, so Go keeps its reading and the engine gains a Legion-owned html-flow construct. Go refuses only the tab-grammar shapes.

Two classes the architect added mid-phase are in: a header row with fewer cells than its delimiter row (the table fix already covered it, 83 documents), and an empty list item in a quote opened after indented code, whose exact document INFRA-719's tester supplied and which turned out to be a family rather than one shape.
The engine also throws on a body holding a block of HTML, which the architect added: it now draws as a paragraph of that HTML and keeps its container.
The simplify pass applied a correctness fix (the refusal's carve-out), not only simplifications; it is recorded in the PR body's Thermo line with what was skipped and why.

The census was re-run whole at this head against base 08c2e8ad after the pod was replaced; it is no longer the earlier round's run against 8db58db4, and production has grown to 14 projects and 35,434 versions since. The answer is the same: 0 changed.
